text: Ancient Empress's Tomb
Area 3
Ancient Empress
Pelulu
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat the Ancient Empress!!
*pant* *pant* ...I hate this plaaaaace!\nAgh, my voice got hoarse...
What's wrong?
Whoa?!
You can see the spirit of the Ancient Empress\nfloating ahead.
A...... Aggggghhhhhh!!
What brings you here? ...What?\nReceive the blessing? ...*sigh*\nIt's the Elves again, isn't it?
Believe it or not, I was once the Empress of\nSlebinia...Why do I have to judge if you are\nqualified to enter the land of Elves?
I've had it. Begone...
Hey, what's with that attitude?!\nThe old guy, Delma told us that you'd give your\nblessing to the people brave enough to come here.
I'm scared of ghosts but I got up the courage to\nget here, you know?! Even if you're a ghost, I\nwon't forgive what you just said. This guy will...
What? Delma?\n... So, Delma said that...
He is the descendant of the general who served me\nlong time ago. And he's no less virtuous than\nthe general, so...
You must be one of a kind...
Very well. You shall receive the blessing if you\nknock me down. Prepare for the battle...
Very well. You shall receive the blessing if you\nknock me down. Prepare for the battle...\nLet's begin!
Great! As I thought, Delma can never go wrong.\nCome over here. You too, Cule girl.\nYou shall receive the blessing...
M-Me? Y-Yes...
You received the blessing from the Empress.\nYou can enter the land of Resistle from now on!
Alright... I've been trapped in here for a long\ntime since the big earthquake occurred, so I lost\ntrack of time.
I was so bored but you got rid of my boredom.\nI appreciate it.
S-She's a ghost but... not scary, is she?
...Oh, right.\nWe should be polite. We must thank her...
We appreciate your help too, Your Majesty!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go out!
Explore the tomb a little longer!
